name: Structural Engineering
boundaries: Structural Engineering: fundamental discoveries and enabling technologies within this field. Include cross-field consequences where the central advance belongs to this field; exclude routine incremental optimization. Use the historical breakthroughs in the prompt to calibrate revolutionary impact.

original_dispositions.reason: Added as STR-10. Overlaps in outcome with STR-04 and in method with STR-05, and those entries are kept.

original_dispositions.original_title: Intrinsic passive damping that eliminates resonant amplification
original_dispositions.reason: Added as STR-11. Overlap with STR-05 is flagged there. Tuned mass dampers are treated as the existing, narrower technology.

original_dispositions.original_title: Perfect long-term prediction of creep, shrinkage, and fatigue
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by STR-09. The entry was widened in wording so those three mechanisms sit inside the lifespan law. The “<3 percent” and “200+ years” numbers were not adopted.
Covered by STR-05 for real-time passive or active change of prestress, stiffness, or geometry, and by STR-06 for slow stress-driven growth. Not given a new ID.
Added as STR-12. STR-07 remains the crack-path principle and is flagged as the overlap.

Demountable steel joints and a two-story bolted-pinned frame have been tested, with main members elastic inside a drift of 1/50 and with reassembled specimens keeping their seismic performance when damage stays in replaceable parts. A 2026 review of precast frames finds only a few tests of a second life cycle. The unfinished work is wider use of a connection strategy that has already been shown, not a missing structural principle. Whole-building, all-material, indefinite reuse with zero loss was not treated as a separate revolution.

original_dispositions.original_title: Bio-inspired hierarchical metamaterials at building scale
original_dispositions.reason: Covered by STR-01. The claim of 50–70 percent weight reduction with equal safety is an incremental efficiency gain and was not given its own ID. STR-06 covers living or growing hierarchies, which are a different mechanism.

original_dispositions.original_title: Integrated structural energy harvesting from everyday strain
original_dispositions.reason: A 2019 review places ambient vibration energy density at about 50 to 250 μW/cm³ and discusses piezoelectric harvesters for sensors and small loads, not for powering a building. A 2024 civil-engineering review likewise treats piezoelectric harvesting as a source for sensors, pavements, and monitoring. “Buildings that power themselves” would require an energy source the structural strains do not supply. Storage of a carried energy supply is STR-08.

original_dispositions.original_title: Real-time physics-based digital twin with failure foresight weeks to months ahead
original_dispositions.reason: It is an instrumentation and model-updating program on top of the prediction problem. Decade-scale mechanistic life is STR-09. Short-horizon collapse warning was judged an important unsolved monitoring problem, not a new structural principle.

original_dispositions.original_title: Eternal-durability material system immune to corrosion, fatigue, fire, and environmental degradation
original_dispositions.reason: That is a bundle of mechanisms. Repeated restoration of capacity is STR-02. Prediction of remaining life is STR-09. Fire-resistant concrete construction and corrosion-resistant reinforcement already exist as partial, costly substitutes. No single missing principle was identified that would make every structural material immune to every one of those attacks.

reconciliation_change_log.change: STR-01 through STR-09 are retained with the same IDs and the same targets. STR-05 now states that passive, load-timed self-stressing is one route inside that concept. STR-07 and STR-04 now point at the new neighbors STR-12 and STR-10. STR-09 now names creep, shrinkage, and fatigue alongside corrosion. The secondary list’s “<3 percent” and “200+ years” figures are rejected as unverified criteria.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: The historical “self-adaptive” item is not lost and is not given a second ID; the rejected figures were not found in a primary source.

Functional-recovery research through 2024–2026 shows design-level recovery measured in months, and the codification effort aims at days to months with an allowed miss rate. Zero repair-level damage as the ordinary outcome is still open, and it is distinct from cloaking and from reprogrammable members.
Measured and code damping is a few percent of critical, and tuned devices reduce, rather than remove, resonance. That is a different principle from a switchable member.

ASCE/SEI 76-23 is a voluntary, scenario-based standard. A guarantee that any single primary member can be lost is still missing, and it is not the same discovery as topological control of a crack path.

reconciliation_change_log.change: The historical list’s four supporting documents were not verified. An Engineering Structures special issue “Materials and Systems for Eternal Infrastructure” (February 2026) was also not found. Those citations are not used as evidence.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: No ASCE/SEI “Vision 2030+” (2025) page listing these ten discoveries was found; SEI’s public vision is a professional-identity statement. No Journal of Structural Engineering special issue at DOI 10.1061/JSENDH.STENG-12345 was found. The NAE page is the 2008 fourteen-challenge list, not a 2025 structural refresh. The title “The Next Decade in Structural Resilience” at DOI 10.1002/eqe.4123 was not found.

reconciliation_change_log.change: Reversible full-building reuse, ambient-strain energy harvesting, digital-twin failure foresight, eternal immunity to every deterioration mechanism, and “50–70 percent lighter” hierarchical frames were not added.
reconciliation_change_log.reason: Reasons are in the historical dispositions and excluded candidates.
